tagline: A group chat with six AI teammates
brief: A Mac app where you work with six Claude Code teammates in channels, like a group chat that gets things done. Warm and human, not robotic or corporate, and distinct from the big chat apps. The mark works as the macOS app icon from 16 to 1024 px, in the Dock, as the favicon, in the sidebar header and in the README, on light and dark.
criteria: Reads at 16 px, works in one colour, says 'you and a team, talking'.

concepts.name: Table
concepts.idea: Your message in the middle, six teammates sitting around it.
rationale: Says what the app is: you plus six teammates
The teammates' own colours ring the coral bubble
Small cut with bigger dots keeps 16 px legible
Monoline rounded wordmark echoes the round dots

recommendation: Final direction: Table, in coral and warm ink.
next_steps: Favicon and sidebar header in public/
